exposure: Timing of Cesarean delivery (during labor vs. before labor)
outcome: Severe acute maternal morbidity (intra- or postpartum)
cohort: 182,300 deliveries in France from the EPIMOMS study (2012-2013)
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of severe acute maternal morbidity compared to vaginal delivery, particularly in women aged 35 years and older.
mod_finding: The increased risk of severe acute maternal morbidity associated with Cesarean delivery was significant for both Cesarean deliveries during labor and Cesarean deliveries before labor in women aged 35 years or older.
